ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, $\angle C = 90^\circ$, $\angle B = 35^\circ$. The perpendicular bisector MN of segment AB intersects AB at point E and intersects BC at point D. If AD is connected, what is the measure of $\angle DAC$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle B=35^\circ$ and $\angle C=90^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle CAB=55^\circ$, \\
Since MN is the perpendicular bisector of line segment AB, \\
it follows that AD=BD, \\
Thus, $\angle B=\angle BAD=35^\circ$, \\
Hence, $\angle DAC=\boxed{20^\circ}$.

method.method_draft: Use coordinates/trigonometry. Read from the figure that AC is vertical, CB is horizontal, C is the right-angle vertex, D lies on BC, and AD is connected. Let C = (0,0), B = (1,0), and A = (0,t). From the text, ∠B = 35°, so t = tan 35°. Since D is on BC, write D = (x,0). Since D lies on the perpendicular bisector of AB, it is equidistant from A and B, so DA^2 = DB^2. Thus x^2 + t^2 = (1 − x)^2, giving x = (1 − t^2)/2. The angle θ = ∠DAC is the angle between the downward vertical AC and segment AD, so tan θ = x/t = (1 − tan^2 35°)/(2 tan 35°). By the double-angle identity, this equals cot 70° = tan 20°, hence θ = 20°.

推理：按坐标法，令 C=(0,0)，B=(1,0)，A=(0,t)。因为图中 AC 竖直、CB 水平，且 ∠B=35°，所以在直角三角形中 t=tan35°。点 D 在 BC 上，设 D=(x,0)。由于 D 在 AB 的垂直平分线上，所以 D 到 A、B 距离相等，即 DA=DB。于是 x^2+t^2=(1-x)^2，化简得 x=(1-t^2)/2。

要求 θ=∠DAC，即 AD 与竖直向下的 AC 之间的夹角。由坐标可得 tanθ=x/t=(1-t^2)/(2t)。代入 t=tan35°，有 tanθ=(1-tan^2 35°)/(2tan35°)=cot70°=tan20°。因此 θ=20°。
